description: Defines the PdfMarkedContentReference class representing a marked-content reference within a PDF structure, including its properties and associated keys.

classes.name: PdfMarkedContentReference
classes.description: Represents a marked-content reference in a PDF structure, specifying the type, page, stream, marker, and identifier.

methods.name: PdfMarkedContentReference()
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class and sets the type to /MCR.

methods.name: PdfMarkedContentReference(PdfDocument document)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance associated with a specific PDF document and sets the type to /MCR.
